summary: Tested M2.S3 CRM Clients module (backend CRUD/filters/CSV) + Settings page Sito web agenzia section (external vs OMNIA template). 15/15 backend pytest tests PASSED. All 7 UI flows PASSED (login, clients list, create with full preferences, open+update status, search+filters, delete, settings persistence on reload). One minor fix applied: added missing data-testid='client-delete-btn' to the delete button in ClientFormPage.jsx.
action_items: Minor: ClientFormPage renders inputs with value={null} when a saved client has null numeric fields (e.g. price_max, surface_max). Console warning: "`value` prop on input should not be null. Consider using an empty string". Coerce null -> '' on hydration in setForm() for SearchPreferences fields. Non-blocking.
Optional: Add data-testid on filter 'Cerca' button and on 'Esci' (logout) link for future regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: clients.py:103 — `update_client` uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) but then iterates and skips None values; this means clients cannot explicitly clear a field by sending null. Acceptable for PATCH semantics but worth documenting.

clients.py:215 — `db.clients.insert_many(docs)` is not wrapped in try/except; on duplicate-key or partial failure, the whole batch aborts but the API still returns imported=0 errors=[]. Consider per-doc insert_one to give granular error reporting for the CSV importer.

ClientFormPage.jsx is 473 lines — close to the 700-line guideline but contains static constants (PROPERTY_TYPES, FEATURES, etc.) that could be extracted to /shared/constants/clientPreferences.js for reuse by future Match (M2.S4) module.
_strip() correctly excludes _id from all client responses. agency_id enforced on every query — multi-tenant isolation verified.
